source.title: 60 MIN FULL BODY WORKOUT | No Repeat | No Equipment | Rowan Row

notes: Checked against the video, one sample every 20 s over the whole video (name, percent bar and ring timer read together). WORKOUT STARTS IN: 3 at 56 s. A warm-up of ten 30 s moves from 60 s, a 60 s rest, then four blocks of 40 s moves every 60 s (15, 15, 10 and 10 moves) with a 60 s rest after each, then ten 30 s stretches (left and right as two steps). Thin light grey capitals about 9 px high over a bright sky: the draft reads them badly (see corpus.json). 0-60 s and 3878-3937 s are null.
